videos.title: A Pet Carried a Raid Boss's Plague Into World of Warcraft's Cities
videos.description:
In September 2005, World of Warcraft's new Zul'Gurub raid gave its boss, Hakkar, a contagious spell called Corrupted Blood, and a bug let hunter and warlock pets carry it out of the dungeon and into the capital cities. Shopkeepers and guards caught it but didn't die, so they kept infecting everyone who walked past, and the BBC reported deaths thought to be in the thousands. Players fled, healers rushed in, and some spread it on purpose. Blizzard's quick fixes didn't hold, it restarted its servers about a week in, and the real fix, a patch that made pets immune, took nearly a month. Blizzard called it just a bug. Epidemiologists wrote it up in 2007, in Epidemiology and The Lancet Infectious Diseases.
